message.content: {"items":[{"title":"Frauen in der DDR 1984","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1354","justification":"Survey of women in the GDR in 1984, includes attitudes toward gender roles, employment, family, and everyday life, making it directly relevant to gender and gender roles in the GDR during the 1980s."},{"title":"Frauen in der DDR 1988","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1355","justification":"Follow-up study on women in the GDR in 1988, covering role in family and work, political and social orientations; explicitly focused on women’s roles and conditions in the late 1980s GDR."},{"title":"Männer und Frauen in der DDR 1986","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1356","justification":"Survey including both men and women in the GDR in 1986, with modules on division of labor in household and family, employment, and role expectations, which directly addresses gender roles."},{"title":"Familie und Beruf im Lebenslauf von Frauen in der DDR 1985","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1357","justification":"Dataset focuses on women’s life courses in the GDR, particularly the combination of family and employment in 1985, providing empirical evidence on gendered role expectations and practices."},{"title":"Einstellungen zu Familie, Beruf und Gleichberechtigung in der DDR 1982","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1358","justification":"Study of attitudes in the GDR to family, employment, and gender equality in 1982, directly addressing norms and values around gender roles during the early 1980s."},{"title":"Ehe, Familie und Frauenarbeit in der DDR 1983","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1359","justification":"Survey on marriage, family and women’s work in the GDR in 1983; explicitly examines the interplay of paid work and family roles for women and therefore gender roles."},{"title":"Frauenarbeit und Kinderbetreuung in der DDR 1981","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1360","justification":"Dataset on women’s employment and childcare in the GDR in 1981, shedding light on institutional and social conditions that structured gender roles in work and family during the 1980s period."},{"title":"Jugend und Geschlechterrollen in der DDR 1985","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1361","justification":"Survey of GDR youth in 1985 including questions on partnership, family, and role expectations for men and women; directly related to perceptions of gender roles in the 1980s GDR."},{"title":"Politische und soziale Einstellungen von Frauen in der DDR 1987","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1362","justification":"Study of political and social attitudes of women in the GDR in 1987, including views on equality, work, and family, providing material on women’s perspectives on gender roles."},{"title":"Lebensbedingungen und Rollenbilder von Frauen in der DDR 1980","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1363","justification":"Dataset from 1980 examining living conditions and role images of women in the GDR; focuses on norms and realities of women’s roles at the start of the 1980s decade."}]}
